title: Wonderful way to explore Gothic Quarter
text: I enjoyed walking the area at our own pace.  Stopped for Cappuccino and some Church's with Chocolate along the way and did some shopping.  Not too strenuous to walk and managed to work the audio without too many issues. Only a few restarts of the app

title: Great value self-guided tour with interesting stories and a fun surprise
text:
Downloading and opening the tour was very easy. We accidentally started it at the point where the tour actually ended, so we had to walk back to the beginning. Still, it was helpful that the tour could also be followed in a different order if needed.

The stories were interesting, and the narration was clear and not too fast. The tour also led us through streets we probably would not have explored otherwise. There was also a small playful element included in the tour, which was a nice surprise and made the experience even more enjoyable. The price was very affordable, so we would definitely re
